title: Wicker Park Walking Tour History Trivia and Local Flavors
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the vibrant Wicker Park neighborhood as you stroll from the Polish Triangle through the Milwaukee Avenue shopping and dining district. This guided walking tour circles Wicker Park, showcasing stunning Victorian mansions on Beer Baron's Row while sharing engaging trivia about the area’s rich ethnic and commercial history. Enjoy insights into the local arts and entertainment scene and uncover the best spots to eat and drink along the way. Test your knowledge with trivia, and compete for a special prize at the end of the tour.

- Explore the historic Wicker Park neighborhood on foot
- Visit iconic locations like the Polish Triangle and Beer Baron’s Row
- Engage in neighborhood trivia for a chance to win a prize
- Learn about the area's ethnic history, arts scene, and dining hotspots
